title: Page 136
transc:
9 AM
Van Duzer  Wash D. C. July 27 1864 
Nashville
Emma harsh plunder for Gov Holly Embrace zebra
Yours in relation to Shelter A. C. Gillem
just recd unity Will look after the matter
Wedge zodiac I also read yours about Shelby
Carl Schurz Zebra I appreciate him certainly as
highly as you do pekin but you can
never know until you have the trial how
difficult it is to find a place for
an officer of so high rank when there
is no place seeking him Walrus bolivia End


S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n July 27th 1864 130 PM
Harry Mark Nelson Downing Harriet For Chart Tulip No Watsons 
of Ravens Supper since yesterday yacht A Warden Savoy Adrian
says that Pewter at that place is completed and Paradise
running to Carroll C H Rabbits Pekin at Chester &
at the Pilot yard Augusta has gone to whist with
Write at Wick Steuben or on the Monocacy according as
the Robin attempts to Plum above or below Chapel Lady
